metadata.description: Mods for the house Claude coding workflow. `plugin install` copies a mod into the plugin cache; install.sh refreshes the copy when the repo changes.

plugins.name: walk
plugins.description: The walk this session launched as one task per goal in the task list, and /walk: the goal DAG as a live git graph in a pane.

plugins.name: lessons
plugins.description: Failures and corrections that repeat across sessions become system-prompt reminders, once approved with /lessons.
